project_info.theme: Toyota Hilux urban driving eligibility from July 1
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, orange, white, charcoal, city gray

main_subject.detail: A regulation-explainer poster with Toyota logo top left and a headline stack: 'TU 01/07: HILUX THOAI MAI VAO PHO'. Supporting copy says 'Xe ban tai va xe tai van co khoi luong toan bo khong lon hon 3500kg duoc luu thong nhu o to con'. Centered is an orange Toyota Hilux driving through a modern city boulevard. Along the bottom are three icon captions: 'VAO PHO THOAI MAI', 'KHONG LO CAM GIO', and 'LAI KHOE, PHO EM'. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Bold urban pickup-info poster with regulation messaging, textured headline typography, and moving city-road hero image

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota Hilux urban-use regulation message. Centerpiece is an orange Toyota Hilux driving through a modern city boulevard. Background is a bright skyline with warm haze and moving-road perspective. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, exact headline 'TU 01/07: HILUX THOAI MAI VAO PHO', supporting statement about vehicles under 3500kg circulating like passenger cars, and bottom icons with 'VAO PHO THOAI MAI', 'KHONG LO CAM GIO', and 'LAI KHOE, PHO EM', plus the footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: photoreal automotive product-information campaign composite, bright urban commercial lighting, glossy highlights and road-motion energy, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped
